original_query: select  sum(cs_ext_discount_amt)  as "excess discount amount" from    catalog_sales    ,item    ,date_dim where (i_manufact_id in (295, 363, 372, 688, 719) or i_manager_id BETWEEN 11 and 40) and i_item_sk = cs_item_sk and d_date between '2000-02-27' and         cast('2000-02-27' as date) + interval '90' day and d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk and cs_ext_discount_amt      > (          select             1.3 * avg(cs_ext_discount_amt)          from             catalog_sales            ,date_dim          where               cs_item_sk = i_item_sk           and d_date between '2000-02-27' and                              cast('2000-02-27' as date) + interval '90' day           and d_date_sk = cs_sold_date_sk           and cs_list_price between 260 and 289           and cs_sales_price / cs_list_price BETWEEN 75 * 0.01 AND 95 * 0.01       ) order by sum(cs_ext_discount_amt) limit 100;
rewritten_query:
WITH item_threshold AS (
    SELECT
        cs.cs_item_sk,
        1.3 * AVG(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS threshold
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim d
      ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-02-27'
                       AND DATE '2000-02-27' + INTERVAL '90' day
      AND cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 260 AND 289
      AND cs.cs_sales_price / cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 0.75 AND 0.95
    GROUP BY cs.cs_item_sk
)
SELECT
    SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt) AS "excess discount amount"
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN item i
  ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN date_dim d
  ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
JOIN item_threshold it
  ON it.cs_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
WHERE (i.i_manufact_id IN (295, 363, 372, 688, 719)
       OR i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 11 AND 40)
  AND d.d_date BETWEEN DATE '2000-02-27'
                   AND DATE '2000-02-27' + INTERVAL '90' day
  AND cs.cs_ext_discount_amt > it.threshold
ORDER BY SUM(cs.cs_ext_discount_amt)
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Decorrelate the scalar subquery into a per-item threshold CTE (item_threshold), computing 1.3*AVG(cs_ext_discount_amt) grouped by cs_item_sk once, then joining it to the outer query instead of re-executing the correlated aggregate per row.
Fold constant expressions 75*0.01 and 95*0.01 into 0.75 and 0.95.

Convert the implicit comma-separated join into explicit JOIN syntax; keep the item manufacturer/manager predicate in the outer query so the threshold aggregate is computed without the item filter, preserving exact threshold values.
Retain the date-range predicate and explicit JOIN on date_dim; retain ORDER BY/LIMIT to preserve the original query shape even though the aggregate yields a single row.
